questions.desc: Think about actual moments. When do you genuinely feel it?
questions.title: When do you feel most loved?

questions.desc: Not safe like nothing bad happens. Safe like you can be yourself.
questions.title: What makes you feel safe with someone?

questions.desc: The small things that build up over time.
questions.title: What quietly wears you down in a relationship?

questions.desc: Not what you think you should — what just comes out of you.
questions.title: What do you naturally give when you love someone?

questions.desc: Everyone's different. Be honest.
questions.title: How much togetherness and space do you need?

questions.desc: Not perfect — just good. Day to day.
questions.title: What does a good relationship feel like to you?

questions.desc: The non-negotiable parts of yourself.
questions.title: What are you not willing to give up, even for love?

questions.desc: Most people carry something in. What's yours?
questions.title: What fears do you bring into relationships?

questions.desc: Not a holiday. Just a regular day that feels right.
questions.title: What does a normal, happy day together look like?

questions.desc: What actually happens when things get hard?
questions.title: How do you tend to handle conflict?

answersA.custom:
Truly trust each other
Willing to communicate to solve problems even though feeling uncomfortable
